profile.name: MPB连续波激光器
profile.description: 这是一台由MPB Communications生产的连续波激光器，可提供稳定的连续激光输出。实验中常用于荧光激发、光学对准、显微成像以及其他需要可调激光功率的光学测量任务。
profile.description_en: This is a continuous-wave laser made by MPB Communications, providing stable continuous laser output. In laboratories, it is commonly used for fluorescence excitation, optical alignment, microscopy, and other optical measurements that require adjustable laser power.

This is a continuous-wave laser made by MPB Communications, providing stable continuous laser output. In laboratories, it is commonly used for fluorescence excitation, optical alignment, microscopy, and other optical measurements that require adjustable laser power.
